# `aitbc energy provider rate`

Read or publish the AIT/EUR energy rate (EVM contract or native rail).

## Usage

```bash
aitbc energy provider rate [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--publish` | flag | `false` | no | Publish a new rate (requires wallet) |
| `--ait-per-eur` | float | — | no | AIT per EUR rate to publish |
| `--observed-at` | integer | — | no | Unix timestamp when the rate was observed |
| `--source-kind` | text | `manual` | no | Rate source kind |
| `--wallet` | text | — | no | Wallet name for signing |
| `--wallet-path` | text | — | no | Direct wallet file path |
| `--password-stdin` | flag | `false` | no | Read the wallet password from one line of standard input |
| `--password-file` | file | — | no | Path to a file containing only the wallet password (mode 0600, owned by you) |
| `--password` | text | — | no | Wallet password (deprecated: visible in process lists and shell history; prefer --password-stdin or --password-file) |
| `--json-output` | flag | `false` | no | Output raw JSON |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc energy provider rate
```
